airdrops.about: SolPump Airdrop Details SolPump operates a continuous airdrop system that rewards active community members and players through multiple mechanisms. The platform distributes hourly airdrops to eligible participants who engage with the chat community and maintain betting activity. To qualify for these hourly distributions, users must have wagered at least 0.001 SOL within the past hour, ensuring that rewards go to active participants. The airdrop pool grows dynamically as players place bets on crash games, with a percentage of all wagers contributing to the community reward pool. This creates a sustainable reward system where increased platform activity directly benefits all participants. Additionally, new users can claim free Solana cases worth up to 10 SOL by using affiliate codes and connecting their social media accounts. airdrops.about: Tread.fi Airdrop Details The TREAD token is confirmed. The Tread Foundation has announced TREAD, a token used within the tread.fi ecosystem, and has tied the points seasons to it: Season 2 begins only once more token utility is built around TREAD. The Foundation will mint a fixed, capped supply of 100 million TREAD on Ethereum, with no mint function and no inflation. More than half of that supply is reserved for community and ecosystem growth. What is not yet detailed is the airdrop itself: there is no published user allocation, eligibility rule, or distribution date, and no tokens have gone out. The points program remains the practical way to position for any future reward.

steps: Jump to steps Rialo Airdrop Details Rialo has not confirmed a token, an airdrop, or a points program, so treat this page as a way to position early rather than a guaranteed reward. What the team has shipped is a public devnet playground, a faucet, and a Discord role system that tracks who shows up. Those are the records an L1 usually looks back at if it decides to reward early users, and the pool is still small next to bigger testnet campaigns. Latest Update: Rialo has credited retroactive points to early ecosystem participants who interacted through Discord or GitHub, or contributed before the points system launched. If you were active early, visit Rialo Playground , sign in with Google, connect your Discord and GitHub accounts, and select “Connect and claim points” to have your points credited. The retrodrop for social media content has not been distributed yet, and the team confirmed it will be credited separately at a later date.
